name: Start here
about: New to basketball? Start with these. Catch, pass, cut, dribble, and grab the rebound.

name: One-on-one moves
about: Fakes, stops and dribble moves to get past your defender, all by yourself.

name: Getting open
about: Ways to get open, even when you don't have the ball.

name: Screens
about: Stand still like a wall so a teammate can run free. First learn what a screen is, then try the trickier ones.

name: Pick and roll
about: Two players team up: one screens for the dribbler, then rolls or pops to get open.

name: Defense
about: This time you're the red team. Start with your stance, then learn to deny, help, get back, and trap.

name: Inbound plays
about: Plays for passing the ball in from out of bounds, from the baseline and from the side.

name: Beat the zone
about: When defenders guard areas instead of players, find the gaps and move the ball.

name: Triangle offense
about: Learn the triangle setup first, then the four ways to run it.

name: Flex offense
about: Learn the flex pattern first, then its two ways to score: the flex cut and the down screen.
